content: Aaradhya Verma reached out to insurance agent Suresh Deshmukh via chat to inquire about a 15% premium increase for her health policy renewal with Dcoders. Suresh explained that the increase is driven by inflation, rising medical costs, and new policy benefits. Aaradhya asked for details on the new benefits, which Suresh noted include mental health and alternative therapy coverage along with an increased sum insured. Suresh offered to send a detailed brochure, and Aaradhya requested it while asking for confirmation on her current policy status.

action_items: Send detailed brochure of new benefits to customer
Confirm current policy expiration or automatic renewal status
